versions.changelog:
Initial release of ECS Linux OS troubleshooting skill for Alibaba Cloud.

- Provides structured, step-by-step diagnosis for Alibaba Cloud ECS Linux OS abnormal issues (e.g., boot failures, login problems, network/disk issues, performance anomalies).
- Enforces strict troubleshooting workflow with 6 progressive phases and a progress checklist.
- Validates user input for safety and correctness before any remote command execution.
- Uses only documented aliyun CLI subcommands for remote investigation; custom commands are not permitted.
- Includes session-specific user-agent tracing for all aliyun CLI operations.
- Not applicable to non-Alibaba Cloud ECS, non-Linux OS, or control-plane-only issues.
